top_signals.title: US Stocks Tread Water as Focus Turns From PCE to Nvidia Earnings
top_signals.summary: US stocks treaded water on Wednesday as investors digested the Federal Reserve’s preferred inflation gauge and waited for earnings from chipmaking giant Nvidia Corp.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Alibaba Leaders’ Buying Does Little to Ease Share Sale Fallout
top_signals.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.’s efforts to revive sentiment after its $10 billion share placement has failed to dispel investor concerns over how it chose to finance its AI ambition.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nordic Alliance Said to Explore Region-Wide Stock Exchange
top_signals.summary: Some of the Nordic region’s biggest companies and wealthiest investors are working on a proposal to create a single, unified stock exchange.

top_signals.title: Cadmatic Expands US Presence With Local Specialists
top_signals.summary: Marine design software company Cadmatic is expanding its US presence by hiring more local specialists to serve its rapidly growing customer base in the key US shipbuilding market. With demand driven by fleet renewal, naval procurement programs…
